tools.name: base_token_risk_changes
tools.description: Base token change report: compares signed, seven-day baselines with block-pinned owner, pause, proxy and supply reads, plus optional same-pool token balances. Returns field-level evidence and unknowns. No honeypot simulation, sell-tax estimate, USD liquidity valuation or safety guarantee. USDC on Ba

tools.name: get_doi_report
tools.description: Resolve a DOI into normalized publication metadata, citation text, identifiers and source links. Abstracts and full paper text are excluded. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_package_report
tools.description: Inspect the latest npm package release: version, license, dependency counts, engine requirements, deprecation notice and source links. Does not download or execute package code. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_papers_report
tools.description: Find up to five publications with DOI identifiers, authors, publication years and citation counts. Returns metadata, not abstracts or full text. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_npmsearch_report
tools.description: Find up to five npm packages with versions, descriptions, registry ranking scores and source links for package discovery. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_python_report
tools.description: Inspect a Python package’s latest release, Python compatibility, declared dependencies, license metadata and PyPI-reported advisories. No code execution. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_cve_report
tools.description: Resolve a CVE into its published description, status, CVSS metrics, weakness identifiers and vendor/reference links. This does not scan a system or prove safety. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_fx_report
tools.description: Get daily reference exchange rates per one unit of a base currency, with observation date and currency codes. Not executable trading quotes. ECB source data is also available free from ecb.europa.eu. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_country_report
tools.description: Resolve a two-letter country code into its World Bank name, region, capital, income group and lending classification for data enrichment. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: get_economy_report
tools.description: Get up to five recent annual observations for population, GDP in current US dollars and consumer-price inflation. Includes years, units, source links and missing values. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

tools.name: verify_repository
tools.description: Clone a public GitHub repository into a disposable Firecracker microVM, install dependencies, run one declared test, lint, or build script, and return structured logs plus the resolved commit. The service verifies execution, not semantic correctness; private repositories and arbitrary shell commands

tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description: Search the full Saylor catalog of pay-per-call data endpoints (x402, no account or API key). Solana token rug risk and holder concentration, token prices on 25 chains, ERC-20 balances, academic papers, U.S. case law/statutes/regulations, medical and HCPCS codes, drug facts, protein function (UniProt

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Given an endpoint URL from search_endpoints (with its parameters filled in), returns the exact resource URL, price and x402 payment instructions. The agent then pays over HTTP and receives the data. Free.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Current perpetual-futures funding rates across Hyperliquid, Binance and Bybit observations, with venue intervals, annualized comparisons, open interest filters, spread/arbitrage signals, source provenance and explicit execution-risk warnings. Costs $0.002; returns payment instructions for the live x

tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Resolve a street address, place name or landmark to ranked coordinates using OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Returns display names, country/region/type, retrieval time, attribution and scope limitations. Costs $0.002; results are not legal boundaries, navigation routes or survey-grade coordinates.

tools.name: get_snowpack
tools.description: Find nearby USDA NRCS SNOTEL stations and return snow-water equivalent, snow depth, water-year precipitation, temperature, distance, daily observation date and percent-of-median context. Costs $0.002; coverage is mountainous western U.S. and Alaska.

tools.name: find_superfund_sites
tools.description: Find U.S. EPA National Priorities List sites near coordinates or a place, including identifiers, cleanup status, hazard-ranking score, dates, distance and source profiles. Costs $0.002; distances use site reference points and are not a property-safety determination.

tools.name: get_radon_potential
tools.description: Look up area-level geologic radon potential, index, province, geology and EPA screening guidance for a U.S. location. Costs $0.002; this is not a building measurement—any home can have high radon and should be tested.

tools.name: get_sdg_indicators
tools.description: Return latest reported headline UN SDG indicators for a country, with indicator series, values, years, units, earliest comparison values, source provenance and disclosure that reporting years vary by indicator. Costs $0.003.

tools.name: get_evm_wallet_snapshot
tools.description: Read a Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BNB Chain wallet at the live chain head. Returns native balance, requested ERC-20 balances, token metadata and the block number used; this is a point-in-time read, not custody, valuation, proof of reserves or transaction authorization. Costs $0.0

tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: Look up a stock, ETF or index quote with price, change, day and 52-week range, volume, exchange and market timestamp. Yahoo Finance with Nasdaq fallback; exchange delays can apply and unknown symbols are returned as free 404s. Costs $0.002.

tools.name: get_page_metadata
tools.description: Extract title, description, Open Graph image/site name, author, publication date, canonical URL and language from a public HTTP(S) page. SSRF-guarded and does not return the full body. Costs $0.001.

tools.name: enrich_company_by_domain
tools.description: Resolve a public company domain into page metadata and candidate GLEIF legal entities with LEI, status and explicit heuristic verification caveats. Results are leads for due diligence, not proof of ownership or authorization. Costs $0.003.

tools.name: search_eu_tenders
tools.description: Search current notices in TED, the EU official procurement database, returning buyer, title, description, CPV codes, publication date, deadline and source link. Useful for sales-lead and market-intelligence agents; source coverage and filing language vary. Costs $0.003.

tools.name: extract_webpage_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public URL and extract the main content as clean Markdown with title, author, publication date, canonical URL, links and source metadata. SSRF-guarded, bounded and designed for agent research; private addresses, non-HTML files and error pages are refused before payment. Costs $0.005.

tools.name: list_data_endpoints
tools.description: Every currently buyable endpoint in the live x402 manifest, with its current description, price, supported payment networks and payment-discovery links. Free — call this first to see the complete catalog.

tools.name: check_token_security
tools.description: Solana token rug risk check — is this token safe to buy? Mint and freeze authority, LP locked %, top-10 holder concentration, RugCheck named risks, a 0-100 security score and a plain-English summary. Free sample: https://saylorinnovations.com/api/sample/security. Costs $0.01. Returns the payment req

tools.name: check_token_price
tools.description: Fast price and liquidity for a Solana token from two independent sources, with the spread between them reported — a wide spread is itself a signal. Costs $0.001, the cheapest endpoint here, built for polling.

tools.name: get_token_snapshot
tools.description: Complete Watchdog snapshot for a Solana token in one call: price, liquidity, holders, pairs, socials, security flags, and the security/liquidity/momentum/composite scores. Costs $0.005.

tools.name: check_token_narrative
tools.description: Which meme/narrative category a token fits — ai, dog, cat, political, gaming, defi, infrastructure, frog, food, or memecoin — plus its socials. Costs $0.005.

tools.name: check_token_holders
tools.description: Check holder concentration: top 20 holders by balance for a Solana token, with percent of supply and RugCheck's own insider label per wallet — deeper than the rolled-up top-10 percentage in check_token_security. Free sample: https://saylorinnovations.com/api/sample/holders. Costs $0.01.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: OHLCV candles for a Solana token from its highest-liquidity pool — the only time-series data in this catalog; every other endpoint is a point-in-time snapshot. Costs $0.01.

tools.name: compare_tokens
tools.description: Watchdog scores for 2-10 Solana tokens side by side in one request. Priced per mint at $0.0015 — cheaper per mint than get_token_snapshot since the payload is lighter. Good for screening a watchlist in one call instead of one call per token.

tools.name: get_trending_pools
tools.description: Currently trending Solana pools with price, liquidity, volume and 24h change. Costs $0.01.

tools.name: get_recent_launches
tools.description: Brand-new Solana pools, typically seconds to minutes old — the most perishable data here. Age, liquidity, buy/sell flow and conservative risk flags. Costs $0.005.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: On-chain profile for a Solana wallet: SOL balance, token positions, recent activity, sampled age, failed-transaction rate and behavioural flags. Costs $0.01.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Saylor Innovations technical guides (crypto safety, DNS/domains, Linux, IoT/hardware, mining, web scraping, content growth). Free — no payment. Returns metadata only, never bodies.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Fetch a guide by id. Free guides return the full body immediately. Paid guides cost $0.01 in USDC/USDT/SOL on Solana or USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum, via x402 — this returns the payment requirements rather than the body. Use the returned url with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header to complete payment.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category and tag in the catalog, with counts. Free. One call reveals the whole shape.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_endpoints, get_endpoint, get_page_metadata, extract_webpage_markdown, check_token_security, get_guide · Private data: base_token_risk_changes, verify_repository, search_endpoints, get_evm_wallet_snapshot, search_eu_tenders, extract_webpage_markdown, check_token_security, check_token_price, get_token_snapshot, check_token_narrative, check_token_holders, get_price_history, compare_tokens, check_wallet · Public sink: base_token_risk_changes · Destructive: get_package_report, verify_repository.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_endpoints, get_endpoint, get_page_metadata, extract_webpage_markdown, check_token_security, get_guide · Private data: base_token_risk_changes, verify_repository, search_endpoints, get_evm_wallet_snapshot, search_eu_tenders, extract_webpage_markdown, check_token_security, check_token_price, get_token_snapshot, check_token_narrative, check_token_holders, get_price_history, compare_tokens, check_wallet · Public sink: base_token_risk_changes · Destructive: get_package_report, verify_repository

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
